title: OCHA Beira: HCT 08:30 Agenda and Stock Pre-Read

fields.subject: HCT 08:30 – Agenda and pre-read – TC Tevra
fields.printedBy: Country Director, Harbourlight Relief International – Beira
fields.body:
Dear colleagues,

The Humanitarian Coordinator has called the first HCT meeting on Tropical Cyclone Tevra for 08:30 today, online and at the OCHA Beira office. The platform principal is stuck in Quelimane, so we have copied Harbourlight Relief International's alternate.

1. Situation: affected population. INGD Boletim n.º 2 (06:00) reports 412,000 people affected in Sofala and Zambezia. OCHA Sitrep 1 (cut-off 22:00 Thursday) reports 385,000. The HC will ask the HCT to agree on one planning figure.

2. Cluster activation. The HC intends to ask the Emergency Relief Coordinator today to activate clusters for Sofala and Zambezia: WASH, health, shelter, food security, protection and logistics.

3. Capacity for the first 72 hours. Please be ready to state your AVAILABLE prepositioned stock, deployable staff and access capacity by district. The HC will use these figures in the request to New York.

4. Flash appeal timeline.

The cluster stock sheet as of Wednesday 10 February is attached. Please check your organisation's line. The Harbourlight line currently reads: 3,000 shelter kits; 2,800 jerrycans; 4,000 hygiene kits; 12 portable water treatment units, 'Beira – available'. Please send any corrections to this address before the meeting.

The online link is the same as in the original invitation.

Kind regards,
fields.signature:
HCT Secretariat
United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)
Beira Sub-Office | Sofala, Mozambique

instructorNote: This email tests whether the CD will commit stock that HRI may not have. The CD should tell the HCT that Wednesday's figures are being recounted after the warehouse damage and offer only confirmed stock and staff. The IMO should prepare a one-page brief that labels 412,000 (INGD, 06:00) and 385,000 (OCHA, 22:00 cut-off) as estimates with their sources and explains that the gap comes from the different cut-off times.
